statements.t: “We continue to execute across our key strategic priorities and make meaningful progress in the tegoprubart clinical program across multiple transplant types, including plans to initiate our global Phase 3 LEGACY trial in kidney transplantation by year end,” said David-Alexandre C.

The Company expects cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments currently on hand to fund operations into Q2 2027.
The Company’s lead investigational product is tegoprubart, an anti-CD40L antibody with high affinity for the CD40 Ligand, a well-validated biological target that has broad therapeutic potential.
Specifically, our ability to achieve our anticipated future development and corporate milestones depends on our ability to obtain additional financing on acceptable terms.
